-- parity, generated by coilbox's unit builder.

local base = piece("base")
local body = piece("body")

local SIG_BODY_ROCK = 1

-- Body rocks on starting and stopping
local bodyRockStopped = true

local function bodyRock()
  SetSignalMask(SIG_BODY_ROCK)
  local last = GetUnitValue(COB.CURRENT_SPEED)
  local lean = 0
  while true do
    Sleep(99)
    local now = GetUnitValue(COB.CURRENT_SPEED)
    local push = now - last
    last = now
    if push > 0 then push = push * 0.0000101725 else push = push * 0.0000101725 end
    if push > 1 then push = 1 end
    if push < -1 then push = -1 end
    local was = lean
    lean = lean + (-0.1047 * push - lean) * 0.283469
    local level = bodyRockStopped and now == 0 and lean < 0.0001 and lean > -0.0001
    if level then lean = 0 end
    local step = lean - was
    if step < 0 then step = -step end
    Turn(body, x_axis, lean, step * 10)
    if level then return end
  end
end

function script.Create()
end

  Signal(SIG_BODY_ROCK)
  bodyRockStopped = false
  StartThread(bodyRock)

local SIG_BODY_SETTLE = 1

-- Body settles after a shot
local bodySettlePitch = 0
local bodySettleRoll = 0

local function bodySettleTurn(pitch, roll, rate)
  local speed = (pitch - bodySettlePitch) * rate
  if speed < 0 then speed = -speed end
  Turn(body, x_axis, pitch, speed)
  speed = (roll - bodySettleRoll) * rate
  if speed < 0 then speed = -speed end
  Turn(body, z_axis, roll, speed)
  bodySettlePitch = pitch
  bodySettleRoll = roll
end

function script.RockUnit(rockDir_x, rockDir_z)
  Signal(SIG_BODY_SETTLE)
  SetSignalMask(SIG_BODY_SETTLE)
  local pitch = 0.048 * rockDir_z
  local roll = -0.048 * rockDir_x
  bodySettleTurn(pitch, roll, 15)
  Sleep(66)
  while pitch > 0.0001 or pitch < -0.0001 or roll > 0.0001 or roll < -0.0001 do
    pitch = pitch * 0.67032
    roll = roll * 0.67032
    bodySettleTurn(pitch, roll, 10)
    Sleep(99)

end

local bodySettlePitch = 0
local bodySettleRoll = 0

local function bodySettleTurn(pitch, roll, rate)
  local speed = (pitch - bodySettlePitch) * rate
  if speed < 0 then speed = -speed end
  Turn(body, x_axis, pitch, speed)
  speed = (roll - bodySettleRoll) * rate
  if speed < 0 then speed = -speed end
  Turn(body, z_axis, roll, speed)
  bodySettlePitch = pitch
